title: A GUY WHO KNOWS A GUY
title_background: A GUY WHO KNOWS A GUY
text: Draw a card. If you played two or more Characters this turn, draw another.

title: BLOCK PARTY
text: Heal each allied Character by 3 and clear Paralysed from them.

title: CALL IN A FAVOR
text: Examine the top five cards of your deck. Put a Character into your hand, then shuffle the rest into your deck.

title: CITYWIDE SEARCH
text: Examine the top seven cards of your deck. Put two into your hand and the rest on the bottom in any order.

title: COIN
text: Gain 1 mana.

title: EMERGENCY RATIONS DROP
text: Summon up to three Emergency Snack Larvae in empty allied slots.

title: EMERGENCY TELEPORT
text: Return an allied Character to your hand; gain 1 mana.

title: FORCED METAMORPHOSIS
text: Destroy an allied Character that costs 5 or less. Summon a random Invader that costs exactly 2 more.

title: LOST AND FOUND
text: Return Equipment from your discard pile to your hand; draw a card.

title: NEIGHBORHOOD RALLY
text: Allied Characters get +2/+2 until the start of your next turn.

title: ORBITAL BARRAGE
text: Deal 2 damage to a random enemy Character three times. The same Character may be hit more than once.

title: PSYCHIC UNDERTOW
text: Put an enemy Character into its owner's deck, then its owner shuffles and draws a card.

title: RUSH-HOUR DETOUR
text: Return a Character to its owner's hand. It costs 1 more until the end of its owner's next turn.

title: SHARED INSTINCT
text: Until end of turn, set an allied Invader's Attack and HP equal to another allied Invader's Attack and HP.

title: SHED THE HUSK
text: Return an allied Character to your hand; heal yourself by 2.

title: SHORTCUT THROUGH THE SEWERS
text: Return an allied Character to your hand; draw a card.

title: SYSTEM RESET
text: Silence a Character; draw a card.

title: TEMPORAL REWIND
text: Return every Character to its owner's hand.

title: THE CITY NEVER SLEEPS
text: Unexhaust all allied Characters. They get +2 Attack and Fury this turn.

title: ZERO-GRAVITY BUBBLE
text: An allied Character gains Flying and Shell.
